title: lolium perenne var. aristatum
intro: Lolium perenne var. aristatum, commonly known as tall fescue, is a type of perennial grass native to Europe and Western Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of tall fescue are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Furthermore, tall fescue has been studied for its potential in treating various diseases, including cancer, cardiovascular disorders, and neurological conditions, due to its unique bioactive profile.
